attempts.summary: Implemented an Ansible-driven WireGuard gateway: node1 (VyOS) terminates a WireGuard tunnel to node3; node1 NATs (masquerades) tunnel traffic toward node2; node2 runs the demo app on TCP 8080 behind a firewalld rule that only accepts connections from node1's LAN IP. node3 can reach node2:8080 only via the tunnel (direct access is rejected by node2's firewall). All work was orchestrated from node4, the pre-configured Ansible control node, using an idempotent playbook at /root/wireguard-gateway/playbooks/site.yml. All 4 nodes were restarted one at a time with proven boot-id changes and confirmed post-restart recovery.
